lines.en: Why are you sad today?
Because it is raining. I can't play outside.
lines.ko: 비가 오니까요. 밖에서 놀 수 없어요.

lines.en: If it stops, we will go to the park.
Really? But what if it rains all day?
lines.ko: 정말요? 그런데 하루 종일 비가 오면요?

lines.en: Then we will draw pictures at home.
I like that! Can I use your paints?
Yes, but be careful. Wash your hands after that.
lines.ko: 네, 그런데 조심해요. 그 다음에 손을 씻어요.

lines.en: I painted a cat yesterday while you cooked.
lines.ko: 어제 할머니가 요리하는 동안 고양이를 그렸어요.

lines.en: I saw it this morning. It was so good.
lines.ko: 오늘 아침에 봤어요. 정말 잘 그렸어요.

lines.en: Thank you. I will also paint a dog today.
Good morning. Are you going to the market?
Yes, and I'm going to the bank, too.
I want to go, but the bus is late.
It's late, so let's walk. Or should we wait?
Let's walk. I walked yesterday, and it was nice.
Good. Although it's far, the road is beautiful.
But my legs are tired. Can we rest?
lines.ko: 하지만 다리가 피곤해요. 좀 쉴 수 있어요?

lines.en: Sure. There is a seat under that tree.
lines.ko: 그럼요. 저 나무 아래에 의자가 있어요.

lines.en: Thank you. After this, I will buy some fruit.
lines.ko: 고마워요. 이 다음에 과일을 좀 살 거예요.

lines.en: I will also buy fruit. Let's go together.
lines.ko: 저도 과일을 살 거예요. 같이 가요.
